result.title: SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution
result.summary: Natural language optimization (NLO) improves an agent by having a model critique and rewrite its natural language policy parameters: system prompts, tool instructions, reasoning directives, few-shot demonstrations. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. We map each failure mode to a matched guarantee: (i) per-block mutability preserves contract text verbatim, with a price-of-freezing bound; (ii) elitist beam search with diversity slots never lets the leader regress on validation, bounds regression under noisy re-evaluation by an exponential tail, and keeps a competitive candidate from a different parent whenever one exists; (iii) a ratio length regularizer comes with an explicit accuracy-length bias bound. Candidates are proposed from dual section-local textual gradients; under a proposer-competence condition whose proxy we measure, edit-graph reachability and a convergence rate bound how quickly improving children arrive. Across seven public benchmarks under five reproduced protocols, SPLICE wins on four and matches the strongest prior method on three. On a production-style contract stress test it keeps the contract clauses that unconstrained optimizers trade away to raise the proxy metric, and ablations attribute gains to critique and elitist search.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPLICE，把自然语言提示优化表述为在块结构化、可选可变状态的编辑图上的约束组合搜索，用逐块冻结、带多样性槽的精英束搜索与长度比正则分别约束契约漂移、谱系坍塌和膨胀。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「块级可变状态+编辑图」、带多样性保持的精英束搜索及长度-精度权衡界，可能为 latent 推理状态的分块更新、推理轨迹搜索多样性与长度泛化控制提供可核查的借鉴线索，但需确认能否迁移到视觉推理。
